description.value: Romeo's Hillside is the original location of this Victoria pizza institution, operating since 1974 near Hillside mall. The family-friendly restaurant has a newly renovated dining room accommodating groups of 30-60, with separate areas for sports viewing and quieter dining. Takeout and delivery are also available, making it a convenient stop for a hearty meal on a city ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the Hillside location at 1581 Hillside Ave with phone 250-595-0212, matching OSM. The site explicitly offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, and as a full sit-down restaurant (renovated dining room seating 30-60) washrooms are a reasonable inference supported by dine-in service. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. OSM opening hours (Wed-Thu 16:30-21:00, Fri-Sat 16:00-21:00) appear significantly outdated compared to the website, which shows open Tuesday through Sunday for both lunch and dinner.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (We-Th 16:30-21:00, Fr-Sa 16:00-21:00) appears significantly outdated; website shows Tuesday-Sunday hours including lunch service and Sunday hours not reflected in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established dine-in restaurant with confirmed open status and matching contact details. Useful to touring cyclists for a substantial meal with takeout option.

Takeout.detail: Website explicitly states take-out and delivery available until half-hour before closing

wow_evidence: original location of this Victoria pizza institution, operating since 1974
